description:
Use this when you need an auditable Japan statutory national-holiday working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a company, school, bank, exchange or prefectural closure calendar.
What it computes: Counts Japan statutory-baseline working and non-working dates for a pinned year range.
Example user requests: Count Japan working days from 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-03-01","end_date":"2027-03-31","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, national_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_legal_bases, weekend_days, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += Japan national status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/japan-national-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/japan-national-working-days-between.md
name: count_japan_national_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or statutory national holiday.

holiday_kinds.description: National holiday or statutory holiday under the Cabinet Office table.

holiday_legal_bases.description: Holiday Act or Cabinet Office legal classification.

holiday_names.description: Japanese statutory holiday names applying on the date.

national_holidays_counted.description: Cabinet Office events in the range.

rest_day_policy.description: Company, school, bank and exchange closures are not inferred.

sources.description: Official Cabinet Office and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Japan National Working Days
